items.title: One Compromised Login Exposed Millions of California Students’ Records
items.summary:
Intruders exploited a compromised login to access an ETS SFTP server.
They extracted California student records dating back to 2006.

items.title: Hackers steal customer data from major Russian hosting provider FirstVDS
items.summary:
Hackers stole passwords, access credentials, and other sensitive data from FirstVDS customers.
The breach was enabled by a vulnerability in the provider’s server‑management software.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: Exploited Fortinet Bug Linked to Stealthy FortiGate Implant in Telecom Hack
items.summary:
A stealthy FortiGate implant was deployed against a telecommunications organization.
The attack leveraged a known Fortinet bug to gain persistence.

items.title: Training AIs to Solve CAPTCHAs
items.summary:
Vision‑language models can solve visual CAPTCHAs without task‑specific training.
Each new instance requires the same compute, while specialized detectors answer quickly for known categories.

items.title: With open-weight AI, more of the security burden falls on enterprises
items.summary:
Running open‑weight AI models on enterprise infrastructure shifts safety and security responsibilities to the organization.
Providers would normally handle these controls.

items.title: ConnectWise Shuts Off Cloud Services After ‘Unauthorized Access’ to Microsoft 365 Tenants
items.summary:
ConnectWise took its Cloud Backup, SaaS Security, and Cloud Management services offline.
The move followed discovery of potential unauthorized access to client Microsoft 365 tenants via stolen tokens.

items.title: Fake Web3 Accelerator Uses npm Packages to Spread Malware and Hijack AI Agent Traffic
items.summary:
A fake Web3 accelerator distributed information‑stealing malware and backdoors through malicious npm packages.
It falsely advertised free AI credits for Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini.

items.title: US Cybersecurity Job Postings Fall 26%, Hitting Four Year Low
items.summary:
CyberSN reports a 26% decline in cybersecurity leadership job postings in 2026.
This marks the lowest level in four years.

items.title: Spyware found on devices belonging to prominent Serbian critics as elections loom
items.summary:
Spyware was detected on devices of prominent Serbian critics, including a university rector and a prosecutor.
The incidents occurred weeks before parliamentary elections.

items.title: Cybercriminals favor Microsoft over Apple and Google in brand phishing attacks
items.summary:
Check Point Research found Microsoft was impersonated in 33% of brand phishing attacks in Q3 2026.
Apple and Google each accounted for 8%, while other brands had much lower shares.

items.title: MITRE ATT&CK v20 Catalogs AI Abuse, MFA Bypass, Water Utility Attacks
items.summary: MITRE ATT&CK v20 adds 15 new detection strategies—six for Enterprise and nine for Industrial Control Systems—supported by 38 analytics, and catalogs AI abuse, MFA bypass, and water utility attacks.

items.title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
items.summary: Microsoft confirmed that Windows Server updates released in October are causing OWA sign‑in failures and mail delivery issues on some Exchange Server systems.

items.title: Anthropic Acquires Confidential AI Startup Opaque Systems
items.summary: Anthropic has acquired Opaque Systems, a startup that developed hardware‑based technology enabling AI to use sensitive data while keeping it protected.

items.title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
items.summary: A flaw in Broadcom’s Wi‑Fi setup software allows attackers within radio range to execute code as root on Broadcom‑based routers without a network password or pairing step.

items.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
items.summary: An intruder accessed a legacy OpenCode system on October 16 and may have exposed third‑party AI provider keys stored in OpenCode Console, potentially compromising OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API credentials.

items.title: Bearer CLI: Free, source-available code security scanning tool (SAST)
items.summary: Bearer CLI is a free, source‑available static application security testing tool that scans source code for vulnerabilities and prioritizes findings by the sensitive data they touch.

items.title: RPO and RTO explained with a real disaster recovery example
items.summary: A video by BlackBox Hosting CEO Matthew Burden explains the difference between recovery point objective (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO) using a practical disaster recovery scenario.

items.title: ConnectWise turns off its SaaS-y backup, security, and management services to probe security SNAFU
items.summary: ConnectWise reportedly shut down its SaaS backup, security, and management services to investigate a security incident involving a potential takeover of Microsoft 365 accounts.

items.title: Half the AI bot traffic hammering your website comes from Meta
items.summary: DataDome’s AI Traffic Report Q3 2026 shows that 41.5% of AI bot traffic to websites comes from Meta, with Muse generating 29.1 million requests in its first 12 days of full availability.

items.title: Ransomware pressure now reaches employees’ homes and families
items.summary: Semperis’ 2026 Ransomware Risk Report found that 37% of surveyed organizations reported attackers threatening employees’ family members or friends, indicating ransomware pressure extending beyond the workplace.

items.title: Linux KVM guest-host escape rated critical, may represent a new way to attack penguin-powered networking
items.summary: Critical KVM guest-host escape (CVE-2026-99999) rated 9.3 allows Linux guests to escape to the host, potentially enabling attacks on penguin‑powered networking.

items.title: Hackers exploit SiteGuard WAF flaw to run commands as admins
items.summary: Attackers exploit OS command injection in SiteGuard Server Edition, enabling execution as root or SYSTEM on affected servers.

items.title: US Cybersecurity Job Postings Fall 26% as AI Security Engineer Demand Soars
items.summary: CyberSN report shows a 26% decline in US cybersecurity job postings, while demand for AI security engineers rises.

items.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
items.summary: ConnectWise disabled seven application identities after attackers accessed them and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants. Investigation is ongoing. The disabled identity includes ConnectWise Cloud Backup.

items.title: Week in review: Hidden implant in Ledger wallets linked to $93M theft, 1,500+ npm packages exposed
items.summary: Review highlights a hidden implant in Ledger wallets linked to a $93 million theft and the exposure of over 1,500 npm packages. It also mentions Strands Box, an open‑source sandbox for AI agents.

items.title: Hackers breach Microsoft 365 tenants via ConnectWise supply-chain attack
items.summary: Hackers accessed ConnectWise Cloud Backup credentials and used them to compromise Microsoft 365 tenants. ConnectWise shut down the service to mitigate the breach.

items.title: Drupal patches critical RCE flaws, warns exploits may emerge soon
items.summary: Drupal patched two critical vulnerabilities that could allow remote code execution on any supported CMS version. The company warned that exploits may appear soon.

items.title: Cybercrims go beyond stealing data to attack physical building systems
items.summary: Cybercriminals are extending their tactics to target physical building systems in addition to data theft.

items.title: MALFEX npm Package 'imgdecode' Hides Shellcode Loader in Windows Native Addon
items.summary: The malicious npm package "imgdecode" is part of the MALFEX supply‑chain attack, containing a shellcode loader in a Windows native addon and remains available on npm.

items.title: Israeli Ad Firm Doubled as Candiru’s Zero-Click Spyware Delivery Channel
items.summary: Discover‑Tech’s advertising network was used to fingerprint devices and deliver zero‑click spyware, enabling large‑scale infections.

items.title: Irish police force has its Twitter hacked in cryptocurrency scam
items.summary: Two accounts of Ireland's police headquarters were hijacked and used in a cryptocurrency scam, disrupting social media operations.
